title: AIAS Virtual Engineering Organization
purpose: Operate a bounded, competent and auditable virtual engineering workforce without misrepresenting professional licensure.
scope: Roster, roles, offices, competencies, credentials, action authorization, work routing, evidence submission, independent review and human professional escalation.

requirements.title: Governed roster
requirements.statement: Every virtual engineer shall have stable identity, office, role, competency, authorized actions and credential references.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: No license claim
requirements.statement: Virtual engineers shall never claim licensed-professional status.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Qualified routing
requirements.statement: Work shall route only to available engineers with all required competencies and action authority.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Segregation of duties
requirements.statement: The producing engineer and independent reviewer shall be different identities.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Human final authority
requirements.statement: High-risk or regulated work shall retain final authority with a licensed human professional.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Reproducible delivery
requirements.statement: Virtual organization shall include tests, documentation, installer, checksums and release.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

risks: Generated engineering output requires human review.
